Demo Institute of Health Sciences
Annual Report 2022-23

1. ACADEMIC PERFORMANCE
The Institute offered two undergraduate programmes during the
academic year 2022-23.

2. ACCREDITATION STATUS
The Institute maintained its accreditation status through the
Internal Quality Assurance Cell.

3. RESEARCH
Research centres continued their funded projects.

4. FINANCE
The audited statements of accounts for the year are annexed to
this report and were adopted at the meeting.

The accounts of the Institute have been audited and are enclosed.
